notes: P1vir infection (MOI 10) of MG1655 wild type and delta-hfq, sampled 0/10/20 min; growth protocol mentions 'dksA strains' but all samples are hfq or wild type (typo assumed). '0 min after phage added' counted as phage-treated, acute. Phage RNA present in infected samples, so mixed_organism left out there; false for uninfected. Phase mid_exponential inferred from OD 0.2 in LB (samples <= 20 min after infection). WT re-read: MG1655 wild type -> wild_type.
